assertion.statement: Support for running Cilium's Etcd instances in the pod network managed by Cilium itself (previously deprecated) has been removed; alternatives are documented in k8s_install_etcd.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Evidence does not name any configuration key or resource that identifies a Cilium-managed in-pod-network Etcd setup.; consequence: Evidence says support was removed but does not state what happens to an environment still using it.
